log: A celebrating city now grows only under a Republic or Democracy, from its second turn of celebration, while it has food to spare after feeding its Settlers, and past size 10 only with an Aqueduct, as in Civ1. It no longer empties its food store when it grows this way (civ-clone/web-renderer#1010).
No city celebrates under Anarchy, and a celebration under way ends quietly when Anarchy begins (civ-clone/web-renderer#1010).
A captured or incited city starts afresh for its new owner: a celebration or civil disorder under its old owner no longer counts towards the new owner's (civ-clone/web-renderer#1010).
